crossRefs.note: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.
crossRefs.keyword: His breasts. or, His milk pails

crossRefs.note: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.
crossRefs.keyword: His breasts. or, His milk pails

crossRefs.note: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.

translations.web: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.
translations.bsb: His body is well nourished, and his bones are rich with marrow.
translations.kjv: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.
translations.asv: His pails are full of milk, And the marrow of his bones is moistened.
